Recorded nflverse release files (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data, CC-BY 4.0), downloaded 2026-10-12
and cut to three clubs (KC, BUF, DET), season 2026 weeks 1 to 5, every column kept as published.
`players.csv` holds only the players in `snap_counts_2026.csv`; `injuries_2026.csv` holds week 5 only.
Tests read these files; they never touch the network.
